issue.title: bob-plugins docs:check rejects duplicate metadata in capture-bullets memory frontmatter
issue.description: Reproduction: run npm run docs:check from bob-plugins. After it refreshes its bob-cli docs checkout to 9e94d1b1, generated-drift validation rejects sase/memory/decisions/capture-bullets-mirror-the-task-block.md as invalid YAML because metadata appears twice (the second key is at line 14). bob-docs lint passes; the generated-drift stage exits 2. The primary bob-cli just docs-check passes on this workspace; this does not make the plugin docs gate failure intermittent.

task_type_fields.node_id: bob-plugins npm run docs:check generated-drift duplicate metadata: capture-bullets-mirror-the-task-block.md
task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same deterministic YAML duplicate-key parse error occurs within the single generated-drift validation run, naming the same file and line; lint passes and the stage exits 2 rather than timing out or recovering.

issue.creation_reason: This deterministic failure is outside the approved tie work and blocks the required bob-plugins documentation gate. Searches and recent-task review found no tracker for this root cause, so it needs a separate follow-up.

payload.entry: Triage 2026-11-27: db5a70cc (fix(memory): repair drawer supersession frontmatter) merged the duplicate metadata keys; bob-docs gen --check reports generated contract content is up to date.
